module: Slow shake filter: adds to the position (amplitudes 0.08/0.05/0.03 m) and to the rotation (10 degrees per meter of offset) sinusoidal oscillations of frequencies 0.05/0.04/0.03 Hz with random phase offsets. Hidden. Returns a constructor.

C.desc: Shake filter. Fields: amp (vec3), freq (vec3), timeOffset (vec3), time.

init.desc: Initializes amplitudes, frequencies and random phases.

update.desc: Applies the position offset and rotation to data.res.
